about.description: A beautiful terminal social client for Mastodon and Bluesky 🐦

name: v0.4.0
body:
## What's Changed
* chore(deps): bump devalue from 5.6.3 to 5.9.4 in /website by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/ricardodantas/perch/pull/33
* chore(deps): bump js-yaml from 4.1.1 to 4.3.2 in /website by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/ricardodantas/perch/pull/31
* chore(deps): bump source-map-js from 1.2.1 to 1.2.2 in /website by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/ricardodantas/perch/pull/34
* chore(deps): bump smol-toml from 1.6.0 to 1.9.0 in /website by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/ricardodantas/perch/pull/35
* chore(deps): bump vite from 6.4.1 to 6.4.5 in /website by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/ricardodantas/perch/pull/45
* ci(website): build site with Node 24 by @ricardodantas in https://github.com/ricardodantas/perch/pull/46
* chore(deps): bump astro from 5.17.1 to 7.3.3 in /website by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/ricardodantas/perch/pull/48
* fix: resolve clippy lints reported by latest stable Rust by @ricardodantas in https://github.com/ricardodantas/perch/pull/50
* fix: send User-Agent header when fetching images by @halcycon in https://github.com/ricardodantas/perch/pull/39
* fix: render downloaded images in the detail panel by @halcycon in https://github.com/ricardodantas/perch/pull/41
* fix: insert pasted text, line breaks included, using bracketed paste by @halcycon in https://github.com/ricardodantas/perch/pull/43
* fix: resolve a default account per network so CLI posting to Bluesky works by @ricardodantas in https://github.com/ricardodantas/perch/pull/47
* docs: align keybinding help text with TUI key handlers by @ricardodantas in https://github.com/ricardodantas/perch/pull/52
* chore(website): use root screenshots/ as the only source by @ricardodantas in https://github.com/ricardodantas/perch/pull/53
* fix(website): lower CSS range media queries for older Safari by @ricardodantas in https://github.com/ricardodantas/perch/pull/54
* feat: view hashtag timelines by searching for #tag by @ricardodantas in https://github.com/ricardodantas/perch/pull/49
* feat(website): add og-image.png and apple-touch-icon.png by @ricardodantas in https://github.com/ricardodantas/perch/pull/56
* fix: use each network's default account for timeline and post actions by @ricardodantas in https://github.com/ricardodantas/perch/pull/55
* chore(website): record npm install-script decisions by @ricardodantas in https://github.com/ricardodantas/perch/pull/59
* feat(website): self-host Inter and JetBrains Mono by @ricardodantas in https://github.com/ricardodantas/perch/pull/61
* feat(cli): add perch timeline --tag <tag> for hashtag timelines by @ricardodantas in https://github.com/ricardodantas/perch/pull/57
* fix: terminal robustness (narrow/wide render panics, panic hook, image timeout, picker startup delay) by @ricardodantas in https://github.com/ricardodantas/perch/pull/60
* feat(website): set social card text in Inter and JetBrains Mono by @ricardodantas in https://github.com/ricardodantas/perch/pull/62
* fix: match Bluesky accounts by DID on re-auth so handle changes don't duplicate by @ricardodantas in https://github.com/ricardodantas/perch/pull/58
* chore(deps): bump quinn-proto from 0.11.13 to 0.11.19 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/ricardodantas/perch/pull/51
* feat: backfill the Bluesky DID of older accounts from new sessions by @ricardodantas in https://github.com/ricardodantas/perch/pull/63

## New Contributors
* @ricardodantas made their first contribution in https://github.com/ricardodantas/perch/pull/46
* @halcycon made their first contribution in https://github.com/ricardodantas/perch/pull/39

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ricardodantas/perch/compare/v0.3.4...v0.4.0
